item.title: Reinforcement learning with prediction-based rewards [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: Researchers have developed Random Network Distillation (RND), a prediction-based technique designed to motivate reinforcement learning agents to explore their environments by fostering curiosity. This method has achieved performance surpassing the average human level on the challenging game Montezuma's Revenge.

item.title: Improving mathematical reasoning with process supervision [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: A new approach in training mathematical problem-solving models involves rewarding each correct reasoning step, known as process supervision, rather than only the final correct answer. This method not only improves performance but also aligns the model's reasoning process with human-endorsed chains of thought.

item.title: Building an early warning system for LLM-aided biological threat creation [ ~ ] [ ◻ ]
item.description: Researchers are developing a framework to assess the potential risk of large language models (LLMs) like GPT-4 being used to assist in creating biological threats. An evaluation involving biology experts and students indicated that GPT-4 offers only a slight improvement in accuracy for biological threat creation, which is not significant enough to draw definitive conclusions. This work serves as an initial step for ongoing research and discussions within the community.

item.title: gpt-oss-safeguard technical report
item.description: gpt-oss-safeguard-120b and gpt-oss-safeguard-20b are two open-weight reasoning models post-trained from the gpt-oss models and trained to reason from a provided policy in order to label content under that policy. In this report, we describe gpt-oss-safeguard's capabilities and provide our baseline safety evaluations on the gpt-oss-safeguard models, using the underlying gpt-oss models as a baseline. For more information about the development and architecture of the underlying gpt-oss models, see the original gpt-oss model model card⁠.
